items.content: Per-channel posting slots are live. Your LinkedIn page and your X account can keep different rhythms now.

Posting slots are now set per channel.

Until today a workspace had one weekly grid and every channel inherited it. That suited a single account and fought anyone running a company page alongside a personal profile. Each channel can now keep its own times, and channels without their own grid still inherit the workspace's.

Open Settings, then Channels, pick a channel and set its slots.
